About me

Infrastructure discipline. Automation mindset.

I support enterprise Linux environments where reliability, precise troubleshooting, and clear execution matter.

My experience includes Linux server management, production support, incident resolution, storage and SAN troubleshooting, NFS mount management, system health checks, and operational automation using Ansible.

I approach repetitive work with an automation-first mindset. I enjoy converting manual validation and support workflows into repeatable, safer, and auditable processes.

I am continuously expanding my capabilities in AWS, Microsoft Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Python, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code as I progress toward a high-impact DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or SRE role.
